title: S3 and Filesystem backend types in public config surface but crash at startup
description: BackendType enum exposes S3 and Filesystem variants. Config validation does not reject them with 'not yet implemented'. An operator who writes type="s3" will pass validation but the startup build_store()/build_block_store() factory will either hit an unimplemented\!() arm or be a missing match arm (compile error if exhaustive). If these types are not meant to be operator-selectable yet, either remove them from the enum or add an explicit validation error: 's3 and filesystem backends are not yet implemented'.
